Problem Statement
Read the names and prices of some products and print the name and price of the cheapest product.
Description
The name and the price of n products are given. Find the product that has the lowest price and print the name and the price of that product. The prices of all the products are different.
Input Description
The first line contains an integer n. (1 <= n <= 20) Each of the next n lines contains the name of a product and the price of the product, separated by a single space. The name is a single word without spaces. The price is an integer. (1 <= price <= 10000) All the prices are different.
Output Description
Print one line that contains the name and the price of the cheapest product, separated by a single space.
Sample Input
3
Pen 10
Pencil 5
Book 45
Sample Output
Pencil 5
